tool_args.rationale: The five paid observations are confined to short horizons, while the target horizon is 24.3 and the candidate law reverses around H≈15–25. Acquire the recommended H=20 slow-horizon probe before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a four-parameter dual-exponential reversal law from the five short-horizon rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Rows only cover H≤0.48 and cannot identify the long-horizon reversal behavior needed at target H=24.3.
More short-horizon data would not resolve the key long-horizon ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to the stated dual-horizon mechanism and would add cost without resolving identifiability.
The verified mechanism note and short-window pilot signature support endogenous horizon-dependent adaptation; a long-horizon observation is the discriminating evidence needed.
